about: What Noah kept and what he rejected, at the game's own pixels. Every row has a verdict he gave himself: `kept` is a pick or a yes, `rejected` a no. `words` say what he said and what exactly he judged; `why` is Claude's reading and may be wrong. Read by app/art/review.py; add a row with `review.py add`.

items.why: a line of action from hoof to antler, fur shaded in small clusters that follow the body, one warm ramp
a crouch with weight in it, ears as the one feature, a dark eye on light fur
